ui.spatial.nvidia.hint: 此选项适合语音，可能滤掉音乐和游戏音效。需本机安装官方 AFX 运行库与 48 kHz 降噪模型；未安装时自动使用轻度降噪。它不加速声学射线，也不改变麦克风。

For speech; it may remove music and game effects. Requires the official local AFX runtime and 48 kHz denoiser model; otherwise light denoising is used. It does not accelerate acoustic rays or change the microphone.
ui.spatial.cacheHint: 声线按预算逐刻计算；缓存间隔是重新采样的最短等待时间，复杂场景可能需要更久。增大预算会占用更多游戏线程时间。
Rays advance within a per-tick budget. The cache interval is the minimum wait before another bake; complex scenes may take longer. Larger budgets use more game-thread time.
